ModMetaData.name: 雷霆白字（Big White Title）
ModMetaData.author: MrTitanium
ModMetaData.description:
雷霆白字mod:当进入特殊地图、特殊群系，或boss登场时，显示一个雷霆白字。类似于《control》或《明日方舟：终末地》的出场方式。 现已支持部分其他mod的特殊地图、特殊群系，或boss。
目前支持： -远古无定形威胁 -失能机关 - The Dead Man's Switch(1.6) 欢迎反馈更多你希望出现的mod内容！
支持其他模组通过 TitleCardDef 追加自己的标题卡。
Big White Title: a huge white title slams onto the screen when you enter a special map or biome, or when a boss arrives — in the style of Control or Arknights: Endfield. Now supports special maps, biomes and bosses from some other mods.
Currently supported: - Ancient amorphous threat - The Dead Man's Switch (1.6) Tell me which mods you'd like to see covered!
Other mods can add their own title cards through TitleCardDef.
